description.value: Sushi Moon is a Japanese restaurant on Grandview Highway in East Vancouver offering sushi, sashimi, donburi, noodles, and hot pot. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, globally sourced ingredients with a broad menu that extends well beyond traditional Japanese fare. Online ordering is available for those wanting a quick meal on the go.
